messages:
Maya: Quick check-in: we need a lean launch pack for Hosted API, Dedicated (reserved), and Private pages. Deliverables: 2 headlines per page, 1-line subhead, 3 social hooks, a 2-sentence benchmark blurb, webinar theme + CTA, and a minimal lead routing table. Can we close by EOD?
Ethan: Ill draft Hosted + Dedicated headlines. Rosa, can you handle Private and security note?
Rosa: On it. Will emphasize compliance and KMS/HSM.
Gabe: Ill draft social hooks and CTA variants for button copy: "Start in minutes" vs "Request a quote". Also recommend tracking headline CTR.
Ethan: Hosted headlines:
A) "Hosted inference that scales with your app"
B) "Production-ready API for low-latency LLMs"
Subhead: "Streaming, transparent cost metrics, and free credits to start."
Ethan: Dedicated headlines:
A) "Reserved GPU pools for consistent throughput"
B) "Committed capacity with SLA-backed performance"
Subhead: "Autoscaling policies, burst options, predictable costs."
Rosa: Private headlines:
A) "Keep inference inside your network"
B) "Private deployment for regulated data"
Subhead: "VPC/on-prem deployments with audit logs and KMS."
Gabe: Social hooks:
- "New: Run LLMs with reliable latency and lower per-token costs. Join our webinar. 🔥"
- "Benchmark sneak peek: same model, 30% lower GPU cost with batching + caching. Read more. 📊"
- "Live demo: routing, autoscale, and private deployment use cases. Seats limited. 🎥"
Ethan: Benchmark blurb (2 sentences): "On a mixed-length chat benchmark (1M messages), Redwood reduced 95th percentile latency by ~40% and lowered GPU cost per million tokens by ~30% via workload-aware batching and prefix caching. Repro scripts and dataset published at github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks."
Maya: Webinar theme: "Serving LLMs in production: cost, latency, and controls". CTA: Register -> tag leads as "webinar-prod-2026". Follow-up: 3-email drip.
Gabe: Lead routing (minimal):
Hosted try -> P3 -> growth-sdr
Hosted heavy usage -> P2 -> enterprise-sdr
Dedicated reserve -> P1 -> sales-enterprise
Private contact -> P1 -> solutions-eng
Webinar reg -> P2 -> nurture
Maya: Owners: Hosted/Dedicated (Ethan), Private (Rosa), Social + CTA tests (Gabe), Lead routing (Maya). Will lock plan and add cards.
